physical_position_cluster.interpretation: Five physical positions with four seed repeats each; not20 independent scenes. With5clusters minimum two-sided sign-flip p=2/32=.0625. This adds statistical context, not a success gate.

gr00t_n16__pi05_mobile.speed_scope: Only same-case both-qualified transport or both-success full task. Empty=N/A; fast failure never wins. Difference is second minus first, conditional on both endpoints being reached.

physical_position_cluster.interpretation: Five physical positions with four seed repeats each; not20 independent scenes. With5clusters minimum two-sided sign-flip p=2/32=.0625. This adds statistical context, not a success gate.

gr00t_n16__official_pi05_base.speed_scope: Only same-case both-qualified transport or both-success full task. Empty=N/A; fast failure never wins. Difference is second minus first, conditional on both endpoints being reached.

physical_position_cluster.interpretation: Five physical positions with four seed repeats each; not20 independent scenes. With5clusters minimum two-sided sign-flip p=2/32=.0625. This adds statistical context, not a success gate.

pi05_mobile__official_pi05_base.speed_scope: Only same-case both-qualified transport or both-success full task. Empty=N/A; fast failure never wins. Difference is second minus first, conditional on both endpoints being reached.

scope_zh: 仅仿真；5个物理位置×4种子重复，非20个独立场景。4m/60°携物阶段达标不等于到达目标、释放、稳定放置或完整任务成功。16/20门槛仅用于完整任务。阶段不确定性不替换原成功判据。
causal_limit_zh: 不自动宣称架构或训练因果，不宣布总体赢家。单回合、最接近距离及接触代理均不可冒充完整成功。
timing_zh: 首次携物时间：trace row0至既定首次carry qualified。wall包括观测后的物理/渲染/录像与推理暂停，不含row0之前冷启动；warm inference为模型推理计算延迟，非整次RPC。仿真时钟与实际墙钟分开报告。
xy_error_zh: 箱体与同期目标容器actor origin的世界XY距离；报告最接近和最终连续数值，没有新增到达阈值。

report_v2_montages.timing: Simulation-time50fps playback; inference/startup pauses are omitted, never wall-clock1x
report_v2_montages.short_stream_semantics: Last original frame held with explicit END OF RECORDING and fixed stopped sim/wall time
report_v2_montages.selection: Same frozen case for every policy; Final outcome label is retrospective, not a live done signal
